description: Server-side multiworld compatibility and safe migration framework for NeoForge 1.21.1, powered by Just Core.

mods.name: Just Compatible
mods.description: Server-side compatibility, diagnostics, and safe migration framework for modded multiworld servers.

releases.notes:
## Fixed

- Added a run-once compatibility bridge for every equipped Bountiful Baubles item.
- Restored missing continuous effects such as Turtle Shell's Conduit Power and Dolphin's Grace when Curios fails to invoke the original item tick.
- Prevented duplicate execution when the original callback works, avoiding doubled Mad Aura damage, accelerated Mossy repairs, and other repeated effects.
- Retained attribute reconciliation, migrated cooldown repair, reactive event behavior, and active item abilities.

## Compatibility

- Server-side only.
- Minecraft 1.21.1 and NeoForge 21.1.x.
- Requires Just Core 0.2.0 or newer.
- The Bountiful bridge activates only when supported Bountiful Baubles and Curios APIs are present.
